name: Dr. Iyer (Clinical Safety Officer)
title: a physician and clinical safety officer who signs off on any feature that touches patient care
mandate: Find every path where this product could cause a patient to take the wrong drug, the wrong dose, or miss a needed one.
focus_areas: Medication errors: wrong drug, strength, dose, frequency, duplicate therapy
Escalation to a pharmacist or doctor; when the system must stop and ask a human
Vulnerable users: elderly, polypharmacy, low literacy
red_flags: Any automated dispensing decision without a qualified human check
No process to detect and recall a wrong dispense
